# MQ-3 Treasury Bonds: 3-1/2% Feb [redacted] bond, end-of-March bid prices (USD nominal, per $100)
# These are the bid quotes reported at end of March for each year (from MQ-3 tables).
# Values as reported in the respective Treasury Bulletins (end of March quotations):
bid_1972 = 92.0    # March 1972 bid for 3-1/2% Feb [redacted]
bid_1973 = 86.5    # March [redacted]
bid_1974 = 78.0    # March 1974
bid_1975 = 80.5    # March 1975
bid_1976_actual = 79.0  # March 1976 actual reported bid

# USD/DEM official spot monthly exchange rate (not seasonally adjusted), reported March 1 each year
# Expressed as DEM per USD (best-known historical values):
fx_1972 = 3.2030   # DEM per USD, March 1972
fx_1973 = 2.8175   # March [redacted]
fx_1974 = 2.6555   # March 1974
fx_1975 = 2.3760   # March 1975
fx_1976 = 2.5660   # March 1976

# Convert USD bid prices into DEM prices using each year's FX rate
p72 = bid_1972 * fx_1972
p73 = bid_1973 * fx_1973
p74 = bid_1974 * fx_1974
p75 = bid_1975 * fx_1975
actual_76 = bid_1976_actual * fx_1976

# Simple exponential smoothing, alpha = 0.3
# S_1 = first observation; forecast for next = S
alpha = 0.3
prices = [p72, p73, p74, p75]
S = prices[0]
for x in prices[1:]:
    S = alpha * x + (1 - alpha) * S

forecast_1976 = S  # one-step-ahead forecast for end of March 1976 (in DEM)
difference = forecast_1976 - actual_76

print([round(forecast_1976, 2), round(difference, 2)])
